share.formula: grounded works t0..t0+2 per million base works (EXP5)

accel.formula: quadratic coefficient of log1p(N) over t0..t0+2 (EXP5)

author_growth.formula: log1p(distinct authors t0+2) - log1p(distinct authors t0) (Pass A)

rao_stirling.formula: sum_ij p_i p_j (1 - phi_ij/max phi), venue-field shares t0..t0+2, EXP6 1998-2002 PMI phi

G.formula: gateway(eig)-weighted off-home landing (EXP5; previously scored on held-out)

REL_home.formula: mean phi(home, landing field) of off-home works (EXP5)

CONTACT_REACH.formula: # off-home fields with >= 1 labelled work t0..t0+2

RETAINED_REACH.formula: # off-home fields with >= 2 works in >= 2 of the 3 years

FRONTIER_POTENTIAL.formula: sum_{k not entered, off-home} mean_{j retained} phi[j,k]

D_rca_end.formula: # off-home fields entered by the RCA rule by t0+2 (EXP6 h2.rca_entered)

D_vol_end.formula: # off-home fields with cumulative >= 2 works by t0+2 (EXP6 h2.states)

M0_density_end.formula: mean Hidalgo density phi[E].sum/colsum over not-entered off-home fields at t0+2

D_z.formula: z of # backbone communities reached by NEW neighbours vs frequency-matched null (200 draws)

D_ratio.formula: observed / null-mean # communities of NEW neighbours

D_sub.formula: z of # subfields reached by NEW neighbours

NOV.formula: share of NEW neighbours outside the W1 dominant community

F_res.formula: growth of mean top-20 neighbour PMI W1->W3 minus multinomial-null mean

str_growth.formula: log(sum PMI W3 + 1) - log(sum PMI W1 + 1)

edge_persistence.formula: mean Jaccard of neighbour sets W1-W2, W2-W3

turnover.formula: share of W1 neighbours absent in W3

participation.formula: 1 - sum of squared community shares of W3 neighbours

comm_entropy.formula: Shannon entropy of W3 neighbour community weights

ego_density_W3.formula: backbone edge density among W3 neighbours

btw_end.formula: betweenness (cutoff 3) of the concept inserted in the kNN backbone at t0+2

kcore_end.formula: k-core number of the inserted concept at t0+2

constraint_end.formula: Burt constraint of the inserted concept at t0+2

S_comp.formula: # co-author components / # off-home early works (with author ids)

S_isolated_share.formula: share of off-home early works sharing no author with another off-home work

O5_rules: year_usable & relation == same; MeSH (non-baseline), Wikipedia creation, Wikidata P571/P575, taxonomy_added_between (ACM CCS, MSC, PACS/PhySH), curated lists except Research Fronts; at risk = no qualifying event before t0; MeSH & taxonomy need year > t0; O5_WW = Wikipedia+Wikidata only; groups with < 20 positives dropped
holm_families: per outcome: the 10 pooled tests of that outcome's frozen top 10
pooling: DerSimonian-Laird over PHYS, LIFEENV, SOC, MATHDEC (Fisher z of psp with bootstrap SE; dAUC with bootstrap SE)

preregistered_predictions.P1: entropy, D_rare, D_ratio, participation, NOV_res: raw Spearman with O2r_m50 > 0 (CI > 0) in >= 3 of 4 held-out groups; AND D_rare, D_ratio, participation, NOV_res: pooled psp|B5 CI upper bound < 0.10
preregistered_predictions.P2: edge_persistence: pooled raw rho and pooled psp with O2r_m50 both < 0
preregistered_predictions.P3: deg_growth, str_growth, new_edge_rate FAIL held-out: pooled psp CI includes 0 OR sign flip in >= 2 of 4 groups
preregistered_predictions.P4: RETENTION_RATIO_early and FRONTIER_POTENTIAL: pooled psp > 0 with CI > 0 for O2r_resid AND O1c
preregistered_predictions.P5: CONTACT_REACH: pooled psp CI includes 0 (also reported given B5 minus reach)
